panels.title: Server TPS (Ticks Per Second)
panels.description: Ticks per second reported by each Minecraft server, from `minecraft_server_tps` exposed by the minecraft-exporter on the XPS (port 9202). Ideal TPS is 20.0; values below 18 indicate server lag. Data source: custom minecraft-exporter scraping Minecraft server metrics.

panels.title: Players Online (per server)
panels.description: Number of players currently online on each Minecraft server, from `minecraft_server_player_count` exposed by the minecraft-exporter on the XPS.

panels.title: Java Heap Used (per server)
panels.description: Java heap memory currently used by each Minecraft server process, from `minecraft_java_heap_used_bytes` exposed by the minecraft-exporter on the XPS.

panels.title: Java Heap Committed (per server)
panels.description: Java heap memory committed (guaranteed available) to each Minecraft server process, from `minecraft_java_heap_committed_bytes` exposed by the minecraft-exporter on the XPS.

panels.title: Java Max Heap (per server)
panels.description: Maximum Java heap size configured for each Minecraft server process, from `minecraft_java_max_heap_bytes` exposed by the minecraft-exporter on the XPS.

panels.title: Server Uptime (per server)
panels.description: How long each Minecraft server has been running, in seconds, from `minecraft_server_uptime_seconds` exposed by the minecraft-exporter on the XPS.

panels.title: World Size (per server, from Crafty)
panels.description: Total size of each server's world directory on disk, from `crafty_world_size_bytes` exposed by the crafty-exporter on the XPS. Sourced from Crafty's server management data rather than the Minecraft server itself.

panels.title: Max Players (per server)
panels.description: Maximum number of players configured for each Minecraft server, from `minecraft_server_max_players` exposed by the minecraft-exporter on the XPS.

panels.content:
## Minecraft Server Monitor

**Device:** Dell XPS L701X (obs-bounce)
**Minecraft Exporter:** port 9202
**Crafty Exporter:** port 9201

### Key Metrics:
- **TPS:** Target = 20. Below 10 = lag
- **Players:** Current vs max
- **Java Heap:** Used vs committed vs max
- **Uptime:** Server process duration
- **World Size:** From Crafty file stats

_Updated: {{__rate_interval}}_
panels.title: Minecraft Summary
panels.description: Text panel with a summary of Minecraft server status across all instances on the XPS, including server count, total players, and TPS overview. Data sourced from both the minecraft-exporter and crafty-exporter on the XPS.
